youtube_short.title: The Backdoor Roth Loophole That Saves $89K
title_alternatives: The Illegal-Sounding Roth Trick That's 100% Legal
Why High Earners Should Still Have a Roth IRA
youtube_short.description: If you earn over $161K single or $240K married, the IRS blocks you from contributing directly to a Roth IRA. But there's a completely legal two-step workaround called the backdoor Roth — and it saves high earners $89,000 in taxes over 20 years. Step 1: put $7,000 into a traditional IRA (no income limit on this step). Step 2: convert it to a Roth within a day or two. The IRS explicitly allows this at any income level. If your advisor hasn't brought this up, ask them why. #backdoorroth #rothira #moneytips #personalfinance #taxes #investing

hook_line: Earn over $161K? The IRS left a backdoor open.
